title: skills: the published lint-rules table says `relationship/master-detail-required` is a `warning`, which PR #22109 makes false on a `controlled_by_parent` object
body:
This card carries the published-skill half of #9139: one table cell in `skills/**` that PR #22109 makes false. The parent #9139 keeps the lint change itself (PR #22109), which is not a governed surface and lands through the queue on its own.

Filing gate: **① a product defect with a named landing site**: published skill text that the parent's change falsifies. `skills/**` ships to customers through `npx skills add`, so the text is published. Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 3 (seat post #18883, `session_01RPo7FUd6bSnAfkWMAKi848`) as a derived sub-issue of the in-flight #9139, from the dev report `6042817677` (`open_questions[0]`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What becomes false

- `skills/objectstack-data/references/lint-rules.md:13` on `origin/main`: "| `relationship/master-detail-required` | warning | a `master_detail` that isn't `required` (a detail can't exist without its master) |".
- After PR #22109 merges, the same rule fires at `error` on a `sharingModel: 'controlled_by_parent'` object, and there it also refuses `required: true` + `readonly: true` and `required: true` + `system: true`. On every other object it stays a `warning`, unchanged.
- An AI author reading the skill learns that the rule is advisory everywhere, and keeps the shapes `os lint` now refuses.

## Landing

- One table cell, net 0 lines (the skill line ratchet must not move): the severity reads `warning`, or `error` on a `controlled_by_parent` object, and the description names the two flagged shapes there.
- `skills/**` is Tier H: the PR lands on an authorized approval or the maintainer's hand, and its skills hunk is reviewed at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.
- **Serial:** after PR #22109 merges. Before that, the cell is still true.

## Reader who acts

The `domain:spec` seat 3 dispatches it once PR #22109 merges (the claiming seat follows its derived work to the end), with a cross-lane note to the `domain:skills` seat.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, repo-scoped, closed included: 「skills lint-rules.md relationship/master-detail-required severity warning controlled_by_parent error」 → 37 hits; none is this. #9139 (the parent) is the first hit, as the positive control; #13699 (closed) is the earlier severity finding that #9139 absorbed.

Dedupe words: `lint-rules.md master-detail-required severity` · `skills objectstack-data lint table stale` · `controlled_by_parent master_detail error skill`
